footer.why: P3: a visible <label for> above the form (outside the flex row, so the 390 row stays input + button) in the footer's label role .nf-head, text FOOTER_BULLETIN.emailLabel (the BASE aria-label string); the aria-label goes. P2 WCAG 1.3.5: name=email, autoComplete=email. Nothing reads the field name: the form's only handler is onSubmit preventDefault, with no action, server action or FormData reader. The lineEdits show the F1 change against BASE; F3 rebuilds the same file on the SAOC grid, so f1-static pins this markup by content (S1), not by BASE line number.

lineEdits.from: .nf-form input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(210, 203, 232, 0.36); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(11, 10, 20, 0.22); color: var(--nc-ground); font: 15px var(--nc-sans); }
lineEdits.to: .nf-form input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(210, 203, 232, 0.55); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(11, 10, 20, 0.22); color: var(--nc-ground); font: 15px var(--nc-sans); }

css.why: P2 WCAG 1.4.11: only the alpha of the input border rises, .36 -> .55. The colour is a literal in the .nf-form input rule (nos-chrome.css:139), not a token, so nothing else changes; the other rgba(210, 203, 232, ...) uses (placeholder .72, .nf-base rule .2) are different alphas on different rules and are untouched.
